name: Gas and solar (example)
description: One region, 2025-2050, 4 seasons x day / night: domestic gas, a gas power plant, solar PV and electricity imports for a growing electricity demand. Scenarios: SC_1 solar 20 %, SC_2 solar programme.
check: electricity produced in each slice = demand
solar runs only in the day slices (CapacityFactor 0 at night)
SC_2: new solar capacity at least 1 GW in 2025, 1.1 GW in 2026 ...
SC_1: solar output = 1/4 of the gas plant output
